اختمرت (form VIII)
# اِخْتَمَرْتُ (iḵtamartu) /ix.ta.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# اِخْتَمَرْتَ (iḵtamarta) /ix.ta.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# اِخْتَمَرْتِ (iḵtamarti) /ix.ta.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# اِخْتَمَرَتْ (iḵtamarat) /ix.ta.ma.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
